decisions.reason: University of Washington 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. UW does not offer EA (only an early-notification Honors deadline and standard priority deadline). No EA applicant/admit numbers reported.
Tufts offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2), no Early Action plan.

Rutgers-New Brunswick uses a priority application deadline (Nov 1) for scholarship/honors consideration; this is not a Common Data Set Early Action plan and no EA applicant/admit counts are published.
Boston University offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2), no Early Action.

decisions.note: Ohio State CDS 2023-2024 Section C22: 29,573 admitted / 48,937 EA applications = 60.43% for Fall 2023.

decisions.reason: Purdue 2023-2024 CDS does not report EA applicant/admit counts in Section C22 (offers EA but suppresses split-out data).
Wake Forest 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. WFU offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2) in this cycle.
University of Rochester offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2), no Early Action.
Texas A&M 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. TAMU uses priority application deadline (not EA).
Lehigh offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2), no Early Action plan.

University of Minnesota Twin Cities 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 indicates Early Action = Yes (closing 11/01, notify 01/31) but the EA applicant/admit/enrolled numerical fields are left blank in the published CDS.

FSU 2023-2024 CDS published as section-split downloads; the CDS-C Section C22 EA numbers were not directly accessible from the public ir.fsu.edu site. FSU publicly reports rounded EA estimates (~32.7k applied, ~12.9k admitted) but the CDS does not contain official EA applied/admitted split numbers in a verifiable form.

Virginia Tech 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 indicates Early Action = Yes (closing 12/1, notify 2/22) but the EA applicant/admit/enrolled numerical fields are blank in the CDS. Virginia Tech does not publicly publish EA-split admission counts.
UConn 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. UConn did not offer EA in this cycle.
Pepperdine offers Early Action / Early Decision only via specific tracks; the 2023-2024 CDS does not show an active EA plan with reported numbers in C22. Application path is primarily ED + RD.
Brandeis 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. Brandeis offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2).
RPI offers Early Decision and Regular Decision only; no Early Action plan.
Santa Clara University 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 indicates EA plan exists but the EA applicant/admit/enrolled numerical fields are blank in the published CDS.
Michigan State University 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 indicates Early Action = Yes (closing 11/01, notify 1/15) but the EA applicant/admit/enrolled numerical fields are blank in the published CDS.
George Washington University 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. GW offers only Early Decision (ED1+ED2).

decisions.note: NC State CDS 2023-2024 Section C22: 11,718 admitted / 29,143 EA applications = 40.21% for Fall 2023.

University of Pittsburgh 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 marks Early Action = No. Pitt uses rolling admission, not Early Action.

Yeshiva University 2023-2024 CDS does not report EA applicant/admit numerical breakdown in Section C22.

decisions.note: SMU CDS 2023-2024 Section C22: 6,202 admitted / 7,646 EA applications = 81.11% for Fall 2023.

Stevens Institute of Technology 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 indicates EA = Yes (closing 11/1, notify 2/1) but the EA applicant/admit/enrolled numerical fields are blank in the published CDS.
Clemson University 2023-2024 CDS Section C22 indicates EA = Yes (closing 10/15, notify 12/15) but the EA applicant/admit/enrolled numerical fields are blank in the published CDS.
